# The Clearing House

> A directory of estate sale cleanout, junk removal, and hoarding/biohazard cleanup companies serving the Charlotte, NC metro area, including Rock Hill and York County, SC. Listings are organized by category with direct phone numbers and, where available, business websites. "Featured" listings are a paid placement upgrade and do not reflect an endorsement or quality ranking.

## Categories

- [Estate Sale & Cleanout](https://clearinghousecharlotte.com/#/category/estate-sale): Companies that appraise, price, stage, and sell the contents of a home, then clear what's left.
- [Junk Removal](https://clearinghousecharlotte.com/#/category/junk-removal): Hauling crews that remove furniture, trash, and debris.
- [Hoarding & Biohazard Cleanup](https://clearinghousecharlotte.com/#/category/hoarding-biohazard): Specialized crews for extreme clutter, contamination, or biohazard situations.

## Pricing for businesses

Every business can have a free basic listing. Paid upgrades, described on the
[Pricing page](https://clearinghousecharlotte.com/#/pricing), are:

- Verified Listing — $49/month: adds a "Verified" badge; contact info and
  service area are manually confirmed. Required before adding the two
  upgrades below.
- Featured Profile — +$49/month (add-on to Verified Listing, $98/month
  total): top placement on the homepage and category page, plus a ★
  Featured badge.
- Category Sponsor — $250/month: exclusive, one business per category;
  includes Verified Listing and Featured Profile benefits plus top-of-category
  placement above all other listings.

Signups for these upgrades go through Whop checkout (opens in a new tab from
the Pricing page), not this site directly.

## Notes

- This site is a client-rendered single-page app using hash-based routing (`#/...`). Fetching any URL above without executing JavaScript returns the same base page every time, which is why business details are given directly in this file rather than left to be crawled.
- Listings change over time (added, removed, or edited through an admin panel). This file is a manually-maintained snapshot and may drift from the live site.
